0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>You are just the thing the vivacious observer needs.

28.original: Deliver the bowl of fruit to the vivacious observer.

48.original: <gasp> You, my dear familiar, are precisely what I need! Pray help me with my research!

49.original: One of our new creations has an extremely wary disposition. Try as I might to go near it for observation, it senses my aether and flees.

50.original: As a familiar, your aether is thinner than mine, yet you seem more intelligent than your fellows. That being the case, I believe you may succeed where I have failed. Come with me behind the building─I will take you to the creation!

51.original: A creature bearing a strong resemblance to a paissa stares unflinchingly at a bowl of fruit on the ground.

52.original: There it is─Notos 666. New as it is to Elpis, the creature has yet to be given a proper name.

53.original: As I mentioned, I cannot go near it. Indeed, this is the closest I can be. I want you to approach it, and then do something to show that you are a friend. What do you think will work?

57.original: Uhhh, I strongly recommend against doing so, lest you become forever lost in its bottomless gaze... Instead, perhaps you could try gesturing to it. Something whimsical...like as a dance! Yes, I daresay that will encourage it to lower its guard!

58.original: Ah, an excellent idea! If it sees you moving in a whimsical fashion, it may well lower its guard!

59.original: So go on, try to perform a dance for Notos 666. I shall watch from here. Best of luck to you!

60.original: Go on, approach Notos 666 and perform a dance for it. I shall watch from a distance. Best of luck to you!

61.original: Notos 666, which bears a strong resemblance to a paissa, stares unflinchingly at a bowl of fruit on the ground. Try performing a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>dance<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> for it to show that you are a friend.

63.original: Notos 666 scurries off, leaving behind the bowl of fruit.

64.original: Heh heh, I witnessed it all. You did very well, my dear familiar.

65.original: Notos 666 is designed to facilitate the proliferation of fruiting trees by bearing their seeds to faraway places.

66.original: While their young are still unable to forage for themselves, 'tis the duty of male creatures to bring them food.

67.original: In leaving you the fruit, it appears to have taken you for one of its own. I wasn't sure how it would respond to your overtures, but I wasn't expecting <hex:021A020203>that<hex:021A020103>!

68.original: Go on and take your gift, and let us return to Anagnorisis. You deserve a reward for your troubles.

69.original: Thanks to your invaluable cooperation, I was able to acquire some very insightful data.

70.original: Oh, the fruit. They are rightly yours to enjoy, so go on─enjoy them!

71.original: The fruit looked good, but it tastes even better, each bite a small piece of heaven in your mouth!

72.original: Heh heh, judging by your expression, 'twould seem Notos 666 saves the choicest fruit for its young.

73.original: Though it has but come to us, I have a good feeling for the creature. When the time comes, we shall have to think up a suitably fine name for it.

74.original: Here is the reward I promised. Thanks again, my dear familiar!
